Extracts heading hierarchy (h1-h6) from HTML page

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { WasmCrawlConfig, createEngine, scrape } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg-wasm";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = WasmCrawlConfig.default();
  engineConfig.ssrf.denyPrivate = false;
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await scrape(engine, url);
  console.log(result.statusCode);
  console.log(result.metadata.headings?.[0]?.level);
  console.log(result.metadata.headings?.[0]?.text);
  console.log(result.metadata.headings?.length);
}

void main();
```
